lines: Situated in that body, even this living soul, by net-force etc. this, pervades the body of darbha and the rest, by own abiding even unconscious.
l4.sanskrit_cite: taddehasaṃsthito@pyeṣa jīvo jālabalādimam dārbhādidehaṃ vyāpnoti svādhiṣṭhityāpyacetayan
